messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bulgarian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bulgarian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
19 Тогава страхът беше малко успокоен, 20 който в езерото на сърцето ми продължи 21 нощта която преминах с толкова жалост.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | Allor | temporal adverb “then” | Тогава | “then” | OK | | fu | copular verb, past “was” | беше | “was” | OK | | la (line 19) | definite article (fem. sing.) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (article encoded in “страхът”) | | paura | noun “fear” | страхът | “the fear” | OK | | un | indefinite article (part of degree phrase) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (merged into “малко”) | | poco | adverb of degree “a little” | малко | “a little” | OK | | queta | adjective “quieted” | успокоен | “quieted” | OK | | che (line 20) | relative pronoun “which” | който | “which” | OK | | nel | preposition “in the” | в | “in” | OK | | lago | noun “lake” | езерото | “the lake” | OK | | del | preposition “of the” | на | “of” | OK | | cor | noun “heart” (poetic) | сърцето | “the heart” | OK | | m'era | clitic + auxiliary, pluperfect “had been” | продължи | “continued / lasted” | OK (semantic match) | | durata | past participle “lasted” | продължи | “lasted” | OK | | la (line 21) | definite article (fem. sing.) | – | – | UNNECESSARY (article encoded in “нощта”) | | notte | noun “night” | нощта | “the night” | OK | | ch'i' | contracted relative + personal pronoun “that I” | която | “which” (relative) | OK (personal pronoun absorbed in verb) | | passai | verb, past “passed” | преминах | “passed” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | с | “with” | OK | | tanta | quantitative adjective “so” (as in “so much”) | толкова | “so” | OK | | pieta | noun “pity” | жалост | “pity” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la` (both occurrences) – Bulgarian does not use a separate definite article; the definiteness is expressed by the suffix *‑ът / ‑та* on the noun. - **UNNECESSARY**: `un` – the indefinite article is not expressed separately; its meaning is merged into the degree adverb *малко*.
All other source words are represented adequately in the Bulgarian rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bulgarian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bulgarian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
